modules.name: Candidate Multi-Identifier Authentication & Salted Hash Verification
modules.purpose: Authenticate candidates via phone, email, or username using salted SHA-256 password hashing with rate-limited brute-force protection.
modules.validationRules: Identifier and password required; minimum password length 6; max 5 failed attempts per IP/account within 15 minutes.
modules.businessRules: Demo candidate auto-created on first login if absent; guest access returns null gracefully without 401.
modules.outputState: Session record persisted; HTTP-only cookie set.
modules.errorHandling: HTTP 401 on incorrect credentials; HTTP 429 on rate limit lockout.

modules.name: Admin Timing-Safe Secret PIN Gate
modules.purpose: Grant administrative access across the platform via timing-safe comparison of master PIN (1234) or environment secret key.
modules.validationRules: PIN must match 1234 or ADMIN_SECRET_KEY using constant-time comparison.
modules.businessRules: Master admin PIN 1234 supported across all cloud and local environments.
modules.outputState: Admin session created with candidateId: 'ADMIN-SUPER', role: 'admin'.
modules.errorHandling: HTTP 401 on invalid PIN.

modules.name: Admin Client-Server Session Synchronization
modules.purpose: Synchronize client localStorage cs_admin_auth with server HTTP-only session cookie cs_session_token.
modules.validationRules: Server API /api/auth/me must return { isLoggedIn: true, role: 'admin' }.
processingSteps: If expired, purge localStorage and prompt PIN
modules.businessRules: Never display empty skeleton dashboard when session cookie is expired.
modules.outputState: Synchronized admin authentication state.
modules.errorHandling: Purge stale credentials on 401/403.

modules.name: Candidate Unique Registration & Account Lifecycle
modules.purpose: Register new candidates with unique phone-based ID format USR-XXXXXXXXXX and initial 0 BDT wallet balance.
modules.validationRules: Phone must be valid Bangladeshi format (01XXXXXXXXX); email must be valid; phone and email unique.
modules.businessRules: Every candidate starts with a clean profile and free platform access.
modules.outputState: New candidate saved in DB; session issued.
modules.errorHandling: HTTP 409 if phone or email already registered.

modules.name: Authoritative 360-Degree Profile Retrieval & Storage Cache Invalidation
modules.purpose: Deliver live candidate profile to client from serverDB, stripping password hashes and hydrating client state.
modules.validationRules: Valid candidate session.
modules.businessRules: Client store.ts must hydrate from this endpoint instead of hardcoded mockUserProfile.
modules.outputState: Candidate profile object delivered to client.
modules.errorHandling: Return null profile with HTTP 200 for guest sessions.

modules.name: Bangladesh Education Hierarchy & Degree Catalog Mapping
modules.purpose: Define canonical ranks (PSC: 5, JSC: 8, SSC: 10, HSC: 12, Diploma: 14, Bachelor: 16, Masters: 17, PhD: 20) and validate degree prerequisites.
modules.inputData: { level, degreeTitle, institute, passingYear, gpa, maxGpa, board }
modules.validationRules: Level must exist in catalog; GPA between 1.0 and maxGpa; passingYear between 1971 and currentYear.
modules.businessRules: Higher degree automatically satisfies lower prerequisite levels in job eligibility rules.
modules.outputState: Education record persisted in candidate document.
modules.errorHandling: HTTP 400 on invalid GPA or degree title.

modules.name: Applicant Document Vault & Government Spec Validation
modules.purpose: Validate and store applicant photos (300x300, <100KB), signatures (300x80, <60KB), NID cards, and certificates.
modules.inputData: Base64 or binary file with { type, category, filename, size }
modules.validationRules: Allowed MIME: image/jpeg, image/png, application/pdf; size strictly constrained per type.
processingSteps: Save in serverDB.documents with DOC-XXXXXXXXXX ID
modules.businessRules: Teletalk standard 300x300 photo and 300x80 signature required for automated tele-talk application filing.
modules.outputState: Document stored in DB documents collection.
modules.errorHandling: HTTP 400 on dimension mismatch or file size overflow.

modules.name: Autonomous Multi-Source Recruitment Crawler
modules.purpose: Collect raw circulars from Teletalk, BPSC, Bangladesh Bank, and Ministry career portals with backoff and rate-limiting.
modules.validationRules: Source must be active in jobSources registry.
processingSteps: Parse HTML links or PDF attachments
modules.businessRules: Never re-download identical PDF circulars already processed within the last 30 days.
modules.outputState: Spider run record created; drafts appended to queue.
modules.errorHandling: Log HTTP failure in spiderRuns without halting pipeline.

modules.name: Circular Table & Position Parser
modules.purpose: Extract positions, grades, vacancies, minimum degrees, and application deadlines from raw circular PDF/HTML text.
modules.inputData: Extracted text string or PDF buffer
modules.validationRules: Input text must contain at least 100 characters and recruitment keywords.
modules.businessRules: Identify official Teletalk submission URL and application start/end dates.
modules.outputState: Structured draft in circularDrafts collection.
modules.errorHandling: Flag draft as manual_review_required if parsing fails.

modules.name: Circular Normalization, Mojibake Prevention & Sanitization
modules.purpose: Standardize raw parsed circular data into clean UTF-8 Bengali typography and canonical JobCircular schema.
modules.validationRules: Title, organization, and deadline must be non-empty.
processingSteps: Map government pay scale to grade
modules.businessRules: Zero tolerance for corrupt encoding in published circular text.
modules.outputState: Normalized circular draft ready for review.
modules.errorHandling: Reject draft if organization name is missing.

modules.name: 12-Factor Deterministic & Gemini AI Verification Engine
modules.purpose: Audit recruitment circulars across 12 mandatory criteria (title, org, deadline, positions, eligibility, fees) with AI hallucination check.
modules.inputData: Draft ID or full circular draft object
modules.validationRules: 12 mandatory checks: title, org, positions, vacancies, minEducation, ageLimit, deadline, fee, sourceLink, terms, quota, contact.
processingSteps: Query Gemini AI if API key present
modules.businessRules: Circulars with confidence < 80% cannot be auto-published.
modules.outputState: VerificationResult saved with confidence score.
modules.errorHandling: Fallback to deterministic engine if Gemini AI quota exceeded.

modules.name: Job Circular CRUD & Sub-Position Structure
modules.purpose: Create, read, update, and soft-delete job circulars with multiple sub-positions, salaries, and eligibility rules.
modules.validationRules: Title, organization, category, deadline required; sub-positions must include title, posts, minEducation.
processingSteps: Generate unique job ID if creating new
modules.businessRules: Deleted jobs are flagged as ARCHIVED or removed; foreign key references in applications remain intact.
modules.outputState: Job updated in serverDB.jobs.
modules.errorHandling: HTTP 400 on missing title or organization.

modules.name: 7-State Publishing Lifecycle & Version Snapshot Engine
modules.purpose: Enforce strict state progression: DRAFT -> PENDING_VERIFICATION -> VERIFIED -> SCHEDULED -> PUBLISHED -> ARCHIVED.
modules.validationRules: Must pass publication validator; transitions strictly follow status_machine matrix.
processingSteps: Check if job status allows target transition
modules.businessRules: Zero unverified circulars may be transitioned directly to PUBLISHED.
modules.outputState: Job published; snapshot created; public cache invalidated.
modules.errorHandling: Reject invalid transition with explanation.

modules.name: Database Job Schema Status Unification
modules.purpose: Harmonize legacy lifecycleStatus ('ACTIVE') and status ('ACTIVE') so Admin Overview Engine reports all 214 jobs correctly.
modules.validationRules: Active jobs must be discoverable via status or lifecycleStatus.
processingSteps: Display > 200 jobs on Admin Dashboard KPI card
modules.businessRules: Admin KPI metrics must match actual database records.
modules.outputState: Correct circular counts displayed on Admin Dashboard.
modules.errorHandling: Fallback to ACTIVE if lifecycleStatus is active.

modules.name: Hierarchical Taxonomy & Automated Keyword Classifier
modules.purpose: Classify jobs into 27 categories (Government, Bank, NGO, IT, Engineering, Medical, Defense, Railway, Education).
modules.validationRules: Category slug must exist in taxonomy catalog.
processingSteps: Normalize text and extract keyword tokens
Score category affinities from defaults taxonomy
Assign primary category and SEO URL slug
modules.businessRules: BPSC and Ministry circulars are auto-assigned to 'government-jobs'.
modules.outputState: Category slug and hierarchy metadata assigned.
modules.errorHandling: Assign 'private-jobs' as fallback.

modules.name: Multilingual TF-IDF Relevance Search & Faceted Filter
modules.purpose: Execute full-text searches with Bengali stemming and facet by organization, district, education, and grade.
modules.inputData: { q, category, district, minEducation, page, limit }
modules.validationRules: Sanitize search string; page size <= 50.
processingSteps: Tokenize query using Bengali stemmer and normalizer
Score jobs across title (3.0), org (2.0), description (1.0)
modules.businessRules: Expired jobs hidden from public search to prevent invalid applications.
modules.outputState: Search results with facet counts and pagination.
modules.errorHandling: Return empty results array with alternative suggestions.

modules.name: Real-Time Candidate Eligibility Breakdown Engine
modules.purpose: Evaluate candidate eligibility (Eligible, Conditional, Ineligible) based on age, education, district quota, and special quotas.
modules.validationRules: Valid candidate ID and job ID.
processingSteps: Load candidate profile and job circular
Calculate candidate age on reference date
Check education level against minimum required
Check quota age extensions (32 for FF/disabled)
modules.businessRules: Never fabricate missing profile data; prompt candidate to update profile if data is incomplete.
modules.outputState: Eligibility breakdown report with rule-by-rule status.
modules.errorHandling: Return incomplete_profile if DOB or education is missing.

modules.name: Personalized Career Recommender & Explainer
modules.purpose: Score and recommend jobs to candidates based on skills, career preferences, education, and district match.
modules.validationRules: Candidate session required.
processingSteps: Load candidate skills, education, and preferences
Rank descending and attach match reasons
modules.businessRules: Recommendations with match score < 50% are excluded.
modules.outputState: Array of recommended jobs with personalized explanations.
modules.errorHandling: Return latest featured jobs if candidate profile is sparse.

modules.name: Job Bookmark & Deadline Alert Tracker
modules.purpose: Allow candidates to bookmark jobs to their personal dashboard and receive approaching deadline alerts.
modules.validationRules: Job ID must exist; candidate session required.
processingSteps: Check if candidate already saved this job
Attach automated deadline reminder to candidate
modules.businessRules: Duplicates prevented; saved jobs sync with candidate dashboard.
modules.outputState: Bookmark record saved in DB.
modules.errorHandling: HTTP 400 on duplicate save.

modules.name: Government Application Submission & Corporate Tracking ID
modules.purpose: Submit applications for job positions, assign corporate tracking IDs (CS-APP-XXXXXXXX), and manage status lifecycle.
modules.inputData: ApplicationRequest payload with candidate and job details
modules.validationRules: Job must be active; candidate cannot submit duplicate active application for same position.
processingSteps: Verify job exists and deadline valid
Send notification to admin and candidate
modules.businessRules: Admin can attach official Teletalk User ID and upload official Applicant Copy PDF.
modules.outputState: Application record created in DB.
modules.errorHandling: HTTP 400 on duplicate application or expired job.

modules.name: Wallet Balance Verification & Revenue Leakage Prevention
modules.purpose: Validate candidate wallet balance before allowing Wallet payment deduction; reject insufficient funds with HTTP 400.
modules.validationRules: candidate.walletBalance >= totalAmount. Clamping to 0 on deficit is strictly prohibited.
processingSteps: Fetch authoritative wallet balance from serverDB
modules.businessRules: No government fee application may be processed without verified payment. Candidate with BDT 50 cannot submit BDT 300 application.
modules.outputState: Wallet balance deducted; transaction logged; application processing.
modules.errorHandling: HTTP 400 on insufficient balance.

modules.name: Wallet Ledger & 100% Free Platform Access Policy
modules.purpose: Record bKash/Nagad/Bank wallet deposits and enforce zero paywalls for browsing job circulars.
modules.validationRules: Amount > 0; unique TrxID.
processingSteps: Credit candidate walletBalance upon payment verification
Enforce freeAccess policy: zero subscription/browsing fees
modules.businessRules: Chakri Sheba guarantees 100% permanent free access to all job postings.
modules.outputState: Transaction recorded; wallet balance updated.
modules.errorHandling: HTTP 400 on duplicate transaction ID.

modules.name: Multi-Channel Notification Dispatcher & Persistence
modules.purpose: Queue and deliver critical alerts (application status, admit cards, deadlines) to candidate dashboard, SMS, and WhatsApp.
modules.trigger: Application state change, admin notification dispatch, cron deadline monitor
modules.validationRules: Recipient candidate must exist.
processingSteps: Save in serverDB.notifications with isRead: false
Update unread count on user dashboard
modules.businessRules: Urgent notifications sent 3 days, 2 days, and 24 hours prior to deadline.
modules.outputState: Notification created in DB; delivery recorded.
modules.errorHandling: Retry failed delivery up to 3 times.

modules.name: Career Guidance Content Studio & Article Engine
modules.purpose: Create, review, and publish career guidance articles, viva tips, and syllabus breakdowns with revision history.
modules.inputData: { title, slug, content, tags, category, metaDescription }
modules.validationRules: Bengali quality score >= 75%; duplicate ratio <= 25%.
modules.businessRules: Published articles automatically generate schema.org JSON-LD.
modules.outputState: Article stored and published.
modules.errorHandling: Reject article if plagiarism/duplicate detected.

modules.name: Structured Data (Schema.org) & Dynamic OpenGraph Generator
modules.purpose: Generate JobPosting schema.org JSON-LD, canonical tags, and OpenGraph metadata for search engines and social sharing.
modules.trigger: Render of job detail pages, category pages, career guides
modules.validationRules: Valid hiringOrganization, validThrough (deadline), jobLocation, baseSalary.
processingSteps: Map JobCircular fields to schema.org spec
Generate OpenGraph and Twitter card metadata
modules.businessRules: Google Jobs compliant schema.org formatting.
modules.outputState: HTML head contains valid JSON-LD and meta tags.
modules.errorHandling: Omit optional fields if absent without breaking structure.

modules.name: Central Governance KPI Matrix & Activity Stream
modules.purpose: Aggregate real-time counts across candidates (41), published jobs (214), verification queue, and operational spend.
modules.validationRules: Admin authentication required.
processingSteps: Count published circulars matching active status
Aggregate activity stream from audit logs
modules.businessRules: KPI metrics must reflect authoritative database numbers with zero synthetic inflation.
modules.outputState: Metrics payload delivered to dashboard.
modules.errorHandling: Return HTTP 403 if admin session is missing.

modules.name: Candidate Application Hub & Quick Copier
modules.purpose: Display candidate applications, admit cards, exam schedules, and one-click form-fill quick copier for Teletalk portals.
modules.validationRules: Candidate session required.
modules.businessRules: Candidates can track government application processing in real time.
modules.outputState: Interactive application hub rendered.
modules.errorHandling: Redirect to /login if unauthenticated.

modules.name: Multi-Subsystem BI Analytics & Data Quality Auditor
modules.purpose: Track candidate registration velocity, application volumes, search query trends, and audit data inconsistencies.
modules.validationRules: Admin authentication required.
modules.businessRules: Flag orphan records and unverified jobs as data quality alerts.
modules.outputState: Analytics payload delivered to BI console.
modules.errorHandling: HTTP 403 on missing admin privileges.

modules.name: Automated Deadline Expiry & Change Detector Scheduler
modules.purpose: Scan circular deadlines every hour, flag expired jobs, detect official date extensions, and trigger alert proposals.
modules.validationRules: Cron authorization secret required.
processingSteps: Check current time vs job deadline (Asia/Dhaka)
modules.businessRules: Automatically maintain fresh job listings for public visitors.
modules.outputState: Monitoring run recorded; statuses updated.
modules.errorHandling: Catch and log failures without crashing scheduler process.

modules.name: Teletalk, BPSC & SMS Gateway Integration Layer
modules.purpose: Interface with government recruitment portals and SMS gateways for notifications and form autofill.
modules.validationRules: Authorized corporate operator or background worker.
processingSteps: Format payload for target portal spec
Transmit via HTTP or operator queue
Receive Teletalk User ID and receipt
Save receipt in candidate application record
modules.businessRules: Preserve applicant copy PDF and transaction records permanently.
modules.outputState: Official tracking ID attached to application.
modules.errorHandling: Flag for manual operator assistance if portal times out.

modules.name: Document Store Multi-Subsystem Persistence & Lock Controller
modules.purpose: Provide atomic, cached, and debounced file persistence for local_store.json with zero corruption guarantees.
modules.trigger: Every serverDB read and write operation
modules.validationRules: Must maintain 41 candidates, 214 jobs, 42 applications baseline.
processingSteps: Debounce disk writes (100ms) with tmp file swap
modules.businessRules: Zero data loss: never wipe collections on server restart.
modules.outputState: Persistent local_store.json updated safely.
modules.errorHandling: Atomic write using tmp file ensures power loss cannot corrupt database.

modules.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Tamper-Evident Audit Trail
modules.purpose: Enforce 28 granular permissions across 6 staff roles and log every administrative action permanently.
modules.inputData: Request session and required permission string
modules.validationRules: Session role must possess permission in ROLE_PERMISSIONS matrix.
processingSteps: Check session role and custom permissions
Allow execution if authorized; return 403 Forbidden if not
modules.businessRules: Audit logs are append-only; administrators cannot delete audit records.
modules.outputState: Action authorized or blocked; audit log appended.
modules.errorHandling: HTTP 403 Forbidden with specific missing permission.
